description: Generate up to five variant combinations using the slide’s saved theme, preserving geometry and background. Waits for newly created choices; reuses existing choices unless fresh=true. May return pending choices from another request: read resource_uri for status. Preview ready candidates using preview_resource_uri, then apply_slide_alternative. Requires configured Redis and a preview matching the current slide and layout. No LLM calls or generation credits. Choices expire. Replaying operation_id returns the original snapshot; read resource_uri for current status.

fresh.description: Request a new batch after the current batch finishes. An in-progress batch is always reused.
fresh.title: Fresh

operation_id.description: Account-wide operation ID, 1–128 characters after trimming. Reuse only for an identical retry.
operation_id.title: Operation Id

name: generate_slide_alternatives
